newsitem.title: UK: UK's Celsis in acquisition, share issue.
newsitem.headline: UK's Celsis in acquisition, share issue.

text.p: Celsis International Plc, a specialist in microbial testing for quality control, said on Monday it was buying Swedish testing company Lumac, funding the deal with an 11.1 million stg rights issue of shares. Celsis is buying Lumac from Perstorp AB for 11.22 million stg, 10 million in cash and 1.22 million in shares. The three-for-20 rights issue is at 100p per share compared with Celsis shares' closing price on Friday of 113p.

Celsis said in a statement the deal would give it a more comprehensive product range and improve market penetration of Lumac's products. It said Lumac was a leader in rapid bioluminescence and microbial testing.

"This acquisition provides an excellent opportunity for us to combine our existing strengths with one of the leaders in the emerging field of bioluminescence-based monitoring," Celsis chief executive Arthur Holden said.
